mechanics.claim: The slow and magic resistance reduction from multiple harpoon casts stack additively and refresh duration, up to 2 stacks.
mechanics.quote: These effects stack additively with multiple harpoons, refreshing their duration and stacking up to 2 times.

mechanics.claim: When Danger Zone is active, Electro Harpoon's damage and magic resistance reduction are increased by 50%, and this enhanced value overrides prior non-enhanced stacks on the same target (and vice versa).
mechanics.quote: the effectiveness of both debuffs on the target are increased to their enhanced values for all stacks of each debuff

mechanics.claim: Each Electro Harpoon cast triggers Spellblade and reduces the Force Pulse cooldown.
mechanics.quote: Each ''Electro Harpoon'' cast triggers {{tip|Spellblade}} and reduces {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} cooldown.

mechanics.claim: Rumble has a stocked charge of Electro Harpoon available even before the ability is learned, and up to 2 charges can be stocked.
mechanics.quote: Rumble stocks an Electro Harpoon charge before the ability is even learned.

mechanics.claim: If cast before Overheat, a second charge can still be used within 3 seconds of the initial cast.
mechanics.quote: If Rumble casts Electro Harpoon before his mech becomes Overheated, he may still use another charge within 3 seconds of the initial cast.

mechanics.claim: The missile fails to fire if Rumble is suppressed during the cast time (a defensive/disruption interaction, not relevant to damage output against a stationary dummy).
mechanics.quote: Electro Harpoon's missile will fail to fire if Rumble is suppressed during the cast time.
